title: Care Center Reference Card: Card Upkeep, Method Changes, Reinstatement Windows and Notice Channels of the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization
content:
Method terms of the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization that govern keeping a card current, changing method, restarting a suspended authorization and how the tenant is told.

| Method | Issuer updates applied automatically (account updater) | Expiry reminder (days before card expiry) | Replacement card or corrected bank details updated on the same authorization | Different method needs a new authorization | Reinstatement needs | Reinstatement window (calendar days after suspension) | Failed-draft and suspension notices by | Enrollment, change and cancellation confirmations by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Debit Card | Yes | 30 | Yes | Yes | Tenant re-authorization | 30 | email and text message | email |
| Credit Card | Yes | 30 | Yes | Yes | Tenant re-authorization | 30 | email and text message | email |
| Personal Checking ACH | No | 0 | Yes | Yes | Tenant re-authorization | 30 | email and text message | email |
| Personal Savings ACH | No | 0 | Yes | Yes | Tenant re-authorization | 30 | email and text message | email |
| Business Checking ACH | No | 0 | Yes | Yes | Tenant re-authorization | 45 | email | email |
| Business Card | Yes | 30 | Yes | Yes | Tenant re-authorization | 45 | email | email |

## Questions this card answers

**Which methods receive card number and expiry changes from the issuer automatically?** The Debit Card, Credit Card and Business Card methods; the bank methods do not.

**How far ahead is an expiry reminder sent?** 30 days before card expiry on the three card methods; 0 on the bank methods, which receive no expiry reminders.

**Can a replacement card or corrected bank details go on the existing authorization?** Yes on every method. Moving to a different method needs a new authorization on every method.

**What does reinstatement of a suspended authorization need, and for how long is it possible?** Re-authorization by the tenant, within 30 calendar days of the suspension on the personal methods and 45 on the business methods.

**How is the tenant told?** Failed-draft and suspension notices go by email and text message on the personal methods and by email alone on the business methods; confirmations of enrollment, changes and cancellation go by email on every method.
